scenes.narration: O S P F version three is O S P F for I P version six. The ideas are the same. But the setup is different.

scenes.heading: The neighbourhood address book
scenes.narration: Each router still keeps a map of its neighbourhood. Neighbours talk using link local addresses, not global ones. You enable it on the interface, not with a network command. It needs a thirty two bit router I D, set by hand if needed. And it adds new L S A types, like the link L S A.

scenes.heading: Setup
scenes.narration: Setting it up takes a few lines. Turn on I P version six routing first. Start the process. Set the router I D. And enable it on each interface.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. It's enabled on the interface. Link local addresses are enough. And some L S A types are new.

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.narration: So, to recap. O S P F version three runs over link local addresses. Enable it per interface. It needs a thirty two bit router I D. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva OSPFv3 lab.
